about_the_game:
Batty Shadowless Adventures is a magical 2D pixel art platformer where you take on the wings of Batty — a mysterious cat or bat (it’s still unknown) — who finds herself in a world of broken shadows.

Batty doesn’t remember who she is or why she ended up here. All she knows is her boundless love for cheese and that somewhere in this enchanted land the answers to her past are waiting. To recover her memories, she will have to fly above the clouds, leap between arches and columns, learn the lunar language, solve puzzles, fight strange creatures, and gather star shards and fragments of her story hidden in these magical places.

The game offers two modes:

  • Endless Flight over a magical world where you can collect cheese and stars.

  • Story Levels, divided into chapters.

What awaits you in Batty’s adventures?

  • Cheese is the key to flight. The more you gather, the further you can soar.

  • Explore enchanted locations — each chapter is a new part of the story and a new setting.

  • Fight spooky-cute original enemies.

  • Uncover hidden memories and star shards — as you progress through the story, Batty’s past will be revealed.

  • Solve lunar mysteries by deciphering the ancient lunar language and unlocking the secrets of this world.

  • Find unexpected friends who will help you on your journey and guide you toward the truth.

Why you’ll love Batty Shadowless Adventures

This is more than just a platformer — it’s a story of self-discovery, dreams, courage, shadows, and of course, a love for cheese.

With hand-crafted pixel art, a retro style, an evocative soundtrack, and a blend of coziness, magic, and eerie mystery, the game invites you to:

  • Freely fly through colorful, surreal worlds in endless flight mode.

  • Gather cheese and stars while uncovering Batty’s forgotten story.

  • Face puzzle-like challenges hidden within pixel adventures.

  • Experience a mix of classic gameplay and modern storytelling.

The magical world of broken shadows awaits you

Every star, every piece of cheese, every shadow may bring you closer to uncovering Batty’s secret.

Will you help her fly, fight, and remember?
Will you solve the mysteries of the lunar language?
Will you dare to step into a pixel dream with no way back?

Chapters will be released gradually, each bringing a new location and a continuation of Batty’s story.

Soon Batty Shadowless Adventures will launch on multiple platforms, and your journey with Batty begins here.

Support Batty! Follow us to stay updated — and get ready to Cheese Your Dream!
